content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Council Member Sarah Lee has called for a comprehensive shift towards renewable energy sources in the city, arguing that it is both environmentally responsible and economically beneficial.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Lee’s plan outlines a phased approach to transitioning public transportation and municipal buildings to solar and wind power. She also proposes incentives for businesses to adopt green technologies and reduce carbon emissions.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Environmental activists support the initiative, seeing it as a critical step in combating climate change. However, some business owners are wary of the costs associated with such a transition.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Economists note that while the initial investment may be high, the long-term benefits, including job creation and reduced healthcare costs due to cleaner air, could outweigh the expenses.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: "We can’t afford to wait any longer. The time for action on climate change is now." - Council Member Sarah Lee
